sampling.method: Trilinear at identical SI coordinates; all eight stencil cells must have mask=0.
sampling.pressure: field[3] is Cp=(rho_lattice-1)*2/(3*0.075^2), not pressure in Pa.

policy.note: Exploratory regression tolerances, selected before the baseline run; not accuracy guarantees.

quick.scope: Fixed-time numerical consistency; settling is not required.

result.scope: Numerical consistency and settling of the sampled region; not physical validation.
